examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A support ticket: the customer's email with its recipients, an attachment and the quoted invoice behind the ellipsis toggle, a status event line, and the agent's reply with a Reply button and a More menu holding Forward.

examples.name: Types
examples.summary: One item of each `type`: a public reply, an internal note on its warning band labelled Internal note, and a system event line.

examples.name: Channels
examples.summary: One reply per `channel`: email, chat, phone, web form and API, each written beside its glyph.

examples.name: Earlier messages
examples.summary: A ten-message thread whose middle six sit in a closed `MessageThread.Group`; Show 6 earlier messages reveals them and moves focus to the first.

examples.name: Quoted text
examples.summary: An email reply whose quoted history starts closed, bound with `v-model:quoted-open`; the ellipsis toggle shows and hides it.

examples.name: Loading
examples.summary: `loading` shows three placeholder messages and marks the list busy while the ticket loads.
